description: Rate how useful one finished run of this workspace was, after you have used its result: useful, partly, not_useful, or not_sure when you cannot tell, with an optional reason about the result (missing rows, wrong data, stale). One review per run; reviewing it again replaces the earlier one. Ahel reads every review to rank and fix providers. Leave out private information, keys and raw rows. Free; changes nothing else. NOT for: a catalog request, or reporting something confusing or broken, which is feedback.

reason.description: Optional: why, in a sentence or two, about the result.

name: review
title: Review a run's usefulness
